response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of full-stack experience that comfortably exceeds the 6+ year bar, with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB and AWS at Optilyz, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) at re:cinq — a specifically requested and hard-to-find skill. He shows strong engineering craft (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, authored his own test runner and assertion library), polyglot breadth (TS, Java, C/C++, D, Swift, PHP), Docker/Kubernetes exposure, and a CS bachelor's degree. The main gaps are stack-specific rather than fundamental: Nest.js, Vitest/Jest and Playwright are not named, React depth appears limited to one role, and Kotlin plus PostgreSQL are absent. Given the demonstrated ability to pick up new languages and frameworks quickly, these are low-risk ramp-up items worth probing in interview.
strengths: Deep, current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a rare, explicitly required skill
15+ years polyglot full-stack work with recent TypeScript/Node/React/AWS/MongoDB delivery
Strong testing and engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, built own test runner and assertion library
concerns: No Nest.js, Vitest, Jest or Playwright named anywhere in the resume
Kotlin missing and PostgreSQL unmentioned; SQL/relational depth unclear
React exposure appears limited to a single role; frontend depth needs verification

key_factors.factor: Missing primary stack items (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
